summary: All four T24 blockers are closed. F-001: a redactable span in a JSON property name now fails closed with reason sensitive-property-name (keys are never renamed). F-002: serialized content is only returned byte-identically when the parsed value accounts for every sensitive span in the bytes, otherwise format-unsafe with reason serialized-content-mismatch; the same adapter now backs src/mcp/redact-seam.ts. F-003: a $ref carrying validation siblings is rejected with schema.unsupported-reference-siblings. F-004: HTML character references are decoded for classification while masking stays on raw offsets, and every img srcset candidate is enumerated; the public-link control is unchanged. RED baseline 14 pass/5 fail; after the fix the focused security/MCP suite is 274 pass, 3 skip, 0 fail across 29 files, typecheck and targeted ESLint are clean, and the T24 probe shows no leak for any finding.

acceptance.criterion: AC2 (AFC-02): synthetic secret is absent from JSON, text resource and error; safe JSON passes its schema; a numeric required field carrying a secret is not replaced by an invalid string (format-unsafe instead).
acceptance.evidence: src/mcp/structural-redaction.test.ts and src/security/output-validation.test.ts are green in the focused run (274 pass, 0 fail, raw .metaproject/data/gdctx/raw/2026-09-06T13-18-20-357Z_run.log); the T24 probe shows secretPropertyName.leaked=false and mcpBoundary.secretPropertyNameLeaks=false (raw .metaproject/data/gdctx/raw/2026-09-06T13-18-25-093Z_run.log).

acceptance.criterion: AC5 (AFC-15): a mixed corpus of safe IDs and real secrets allows no field-name bypass; a URL secret is masked; a public Markdown link is not treated as a network send.
acceptance.evidence: src/security/detect/exfil.test.ts (19 pass with the two new auto-fetch regressions) plus the fixture corpus test; probe autoFetch.encodedHtmlImageChanged=true, srcsetHtmlImageChanged=true, ordinaryLinkChanged=false. Safe numeric IDs and metrics still round-trip (output-validation.test.ts case 1).

acceptance.criterion: T24 F-001..F-004 are each closed by a regression that fails before and passes after the fix; the existing 78 focused security/MCP tests stay green; no reason token or failure text contains the rejected value, a raw secret, or a fingerprint.
acceptance.evidence: RED baseline 14 pass/5 fail (raw .metaproject/data/gdctx/raw/2026-09-06T13-12-32-484Z_run.log) then 19 pass/0 fail (raw .metaproject/data/gdctx/raw/2026-09-06T13-17-47-772Z_run.log). Focused suite 274 pass, 3 skip, 0 fail. Reasons are the fixed tokens sensitive-property-name, serialized-content-mismatch, schema.unsupported-reference-siblings; probe attackerControlledReasons.keyReasonLeaks=false and refReasonLeaks=false. Note: five RED tests exist, not the six the dispatch text expected.

changed_files.change: Added isSensitivePropertyName + the property-name screen in sanitizeJsonValue (F-001, reason sensitive-property-name); added REFERENCE_SAFE_SIBLINGS and the $ref sibling rejection in screenSchema (F-003, reason schema.unsupported-reference-siblings); added validateSerializedContentForTransport with parsedValueAccountsForBytes/reachableScalarText (F-002, reason serialized-content-mismatch).

Added decodeCharacterReferences (decimal/hex/named URL-syntax refs, optional semicolon, bounded repeat) used by considerUrl for classification only, and HTML_IMG_SRCSET enumeration of every srcset candidate with raw offsets preserved (F-004).
validateSerializedOutput helper region only: import swapped to validateSerializedContentForTransport and the body reduced to a delegation.
redactToolOutput now delegates to validateSerializedOutput through the allow-listed ../security/service facade instead of re-implementing the parse-then-restore shape.
